warnings.text: Maximum temperatures in the mid to high thirties and overnight minimum temperatures in the mid-twenties. Severe heatwave conditions are expected to continue over the Arnhem district throughout the week. Severe heatwave conditions over the Tiwi Islands are expected to ease mid-week.
